tickets: W0-4 (lanes, agents) and W0-2 (lane fixtures) of C4 Minimal wave-0 set
title: Doctor record detectors: dev/doctor/lanes.py (status-stale, review-missing, retro-claim, base_sha via allocation commit) and dev/doctor/agents.py (mtime roster)
cut_rule: cut by the merger after w0-doctor and w0-decisions integrate: commit this record's update with subject 'docs: allocate lane w0-doctor-records' (allocated_from = the integration tip it is cut from), then git worktree add .claude/worktrees/w0-doctor-records -b claude/w0-doctor-records-detectors <that commit>; base_sha = that commit (C4 change 2 subject form)
delivers: lanes.py: B.status-stale, B.review-missing, B.retro-claim-unverified, B.base-sha-off-by-one with the fixed predicate (allocation = newest first-parent commit with subject 'docs: allocate lane <unit>' touching the record, else the commit that added it; base_sha == allocation, allocated_from == allocation^); null base_sha on an 'allocated' record is info, not a finding
agents.py: F.agents-not-offered (mtime form: role files newer than the session's first transcript line on resume|compact|clear) and the agents roster context line
fixtures dev/fixtures/doctor/lanes/ (staged gate-hooks.json shape, a06-unit3 shape) built so the vacuous predicate fails the test; clean twins return []
live tree: doctor --surface check findings from B.* on today's records are reported as literal record corrections for the parent, never edited by the lane
required_checks: python3 -I dev/doctor/cli.py --surface check --json (findings listed; rc recorded)
check:research: parent-run, serialized (never in the lane)

resource_admissions.git_hooks: no hooks:install; hk runs only in scratch repositories inside tests

pwf.note: pin in the host env; a Bash prefix never reaches hooks

notes: no hot-spot edits: modules are discovered by core and test_doctor_records.py is picked up by test:doctor's pattern
